## Materials

- 📝 [Template (.Rmd)](hw3/assignment3_blank.Rmd) — start here; fill in each section
- 📄 [Assignment (PDF)](hw3/assignment3_blank.pdf) — readable version of the questions
- 📊 [Data — Part A (assign3_data.csv)](hw3/assign3_data.csv)
- 📊 [Data — Part B (penguins.csv)](hw3/penguins.csv)
- Part C is a simulation study: you generate your own data.

## Instructions

Open the R Markdown template, knit it once to confirm your environment is set up, and complete each problem in the appropriate section. Submit a knitted PDF (and optionally the `.Rmd` source) via Canvas before the deadline.

::: {.callout-important}
Remember to set `eval = TRUE` below when compiling the report.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Reproducibility
Set a random seed at the top of your `.Rmd` so your simulation results don't change between knits. Use `set.seed(42)` (or any fixed integer).
:::
